products.name: Aquapolis Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs. TCGplayer lists no booster box for this set, so it is priced at 36 packs. The real box also held one of four e-Card box toppers, which are not simulated.

products.name: Theme Deck "Rock Garden"
products.note: A 60-card Aquapolis theme deck, featuring Nidoking (Aquapolis 24); metal silver Pikachu coin + markers. Not simulated: coin and markers. List: Bulbapedia deck page and PokeBeach's Aquapolis theme-deck page (they differ by a card in places).
products.priceSource: No TCGplayer price for the sealed deck (it is not listed there at all): the sum of its 60 cards at the site's card prices (TCGplayer market, Unlimited). A sealed deck sells for more.
